items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Harris, the guy that's got the Midnight Special Show, the producer, he says...

ctx.x: Oh, that was funny. Well, you know who cracked up about it. Now we sat there, and Harris, the guy that's got the Midnight Special Show, the producer, he says, 'Now, what we are going to do is have black dresses, like black velvet, that kind of thing, and we'll superimpose with the trombones, which will be gold, which makes a great combination.' And this is a funny story. It went down. The dress rehearsal went down just like that until the show time, and Aretha put that green dress on.
